# laravel-grok-bot

> Laravel notification channel for Grok Bot. Each notification starts a run of a Grok Bot routine through its webhook trigger, with the notification's JSON as input; the routine's instruction decides what the Bot does.

- Install: `composer require alfonsobries/laravel-grok-bot` (PHP 8.2+, Laravel 12 or 13)
- Configure: `GROK_BOT_WEBHOOK_URL` and `GROK_BOT_WEBHOOK_KEY` in `.env`; more routines in `config/grok-bot.php`
- Use: return `'grok-bot'` from `via()` and a `NotificationChannels\GrokBot\GrokBotMessage` from `toGrokBot()`
- Check: `php artisan grok-bot:ping {routine}`

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/alfonsobries/laravel-grok-bot/blob/main/README.md): installation, routing, message methods, errors, testing
- [Boost skill](https://github.com/alfonsobries/laravel-grok-bot/blob/main/resources/boost/skills/grok-bot-notifications/SKILL.md): wiring a notification to a routine end to end
